{"consolidated_memory":"## Stale State in ui/state/cacheSlice.ts (TypeScript, Web UI)

Consolidated record of three separate incidents in ui/state/cacheSlice.ts, all manifesting the same symptom but with different root causes. Test coverage: ui/state/cacheSlice.test.ts

### Common Pattern Across All Incidents
- **Problem**: stale state in cache slice
- **Repro**: edit a record, then navigate back to the list
- **Signal**: old value persists in store snapshot
- **Component**: ui/state/cacheSlice.ts (web UI side)
- **Stack**: TypeScript

### Incident 1: [2026-01-07] Floating Point Rounding in Money Path
- **Trigger**: first request after cold start
- **Root cause**: floating point rounding in money path
- **Fix**: moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR**: #3495 on branch fix/stale-state-1
- **Outcome**: error rate dropped from 2.5% to under 8 per ten thousand

### Incident 2: [2026-01-19] Serialiser Dropping Unknown Fields
- **Trigger**: occurred on staging read replica
- **Root cause**: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- **Fix**: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- **PR**: #7025 on branch fix/stale-state-2
- **Outcome**: memory settled at 369 MB instead of climbing past 4 GB

### Incident 3: [2026-07-09] Connection Pool Exhaustion
- **Trigger**: clients pinned to v1 SDK
- **Root cause**: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- **Fix**: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- **PR**: #9382 on branch fix/stale-state-3
- **Outcome**: flaky test went from 99 failures per hundred runs to zero"}
